docs.title: Senior Technical Writer
docs.text:
Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) • October 2025 – Present

  • Authored end-to-end API and technical documentation (manuals, FAQs, Knowledge Base) for secure banking and cash handling ecosystem, imparting enhanced adoption and integration for enterprise clientele.
  • Documented API workflows and system architecture using XR documentation tool catered towards DITA and content reuse principles.
  • Collaborated with engineering, product, and security teams to document authentication mechanisms, encryption standards, and compliance-driven system behaviors.
  • Leveraged G+D’s proprietary AI (Blockbrain) to enhance documentation workflows, improving document analysis, validation accuracy, and consistency.
  • Implemented and contributed to docs-as-code practices using Git-based workflows, improving version control, review cycles, and release alignment.
  • Structured modular, reusable documentation aligned with DITA principles, improving scalability, reusability and searchability of relevant content.
  • Authored machine/hardware-based documentation for legacy cash processing machines used by 100+ central banks worldwide.
  • Ensured documentation compliance with enterprise-grade security and fintech standards in regulated environments.
  • Created multimedia knowledge base (product videos, Machine Usage videos) to ensure enhanced adoption of proprietary software and products.

docs.title: Senior Technical Writer
docs.text:
HBSS Software Solution (QRyde) • May 2024 – October 2025

  • Created developer-centric API, SDK, and SDN documentation for a multi-platform mobility solution (QRyde) used across 100+ cities, improving third-party developer integration success by 35%.
  • Led cross-functional documentation sprints with engineers and PMs, streamlining delivery of tooling and pre-release features to meet global documentation deadlines.
  • Spearheaded the migration to a docs-as-code pipeline, integrating Git-based workflows and automated build systems for content QA.
  • Delivered platform documentation on complex distributed system features, including authentication and scheduling APIs.
  • Initiated and implemented generative AI-based workflows (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT API) to automate changelog generation and streamline draft creation.
  • Managed multi-time zone project delivery through structured updates, sprint demos, and Jira tracking, increasing team velocity by 30%.
  • Collaborated asynchronously across time zones using Jira, Slack, and GitLab.
  • Introduced documentation templates aligned with DITA principles, improving consistency and reducing onboarding queries by 35%.

docs.title: Senior Technical Content Writer
docs.text:
Sprinklr • January 2019 – May 2023

  • Held end-to-end ownership of technical (product-based), Release, UI/UX and in-house content for Sprinklr and its esteemed clientele (Microsoft, Apple, Nike, etc.).
  • Managed and mentored the entire product documentation team; oversaw documentation, communication, and publishing for the marketing team.
  • Executed cyclical projects for product releases, onboarding, training, and mentoring of global customers.
  • Maintained, edited, documented, and published Sprinklr knowledge portal (3000+ articles).
  • Mentored and collaborated with product, marketing, and sales teams across EMEA/APAC/LAD/NA regions.
  • Optimized Jira, Sprinklr, Mindtouch, etc., for agile documentation with high adoption.
  • Produced and maintained end-user content (online help, user guides, white papers) adhering to the DITA model.
  • Utilized Oxygen XML, Adobe Acrobat, and managed sub-maps & high-level maps with reuse strategy.
  • Created multimedia content (product/feature videos) for Sprinklr University and training.
